regions.summary: Install the primary stream and initialize four channel records, each 31 bytes at AudioChannels. Two stream bytes seed each record; the remaining working bytes are cleared. The channel mask selects which records are active. Merge the other priority nibble, load a secondary stream and mask, and initialize only the selected channels. Primary/secondary masks decide which stream supplies each hardware channel.

regions.summary: Build the current room row and return through the transition synthetic continuation. Copy two staged tile rows and eight attribute bytes into the upload queue. Advance the wrapped row cursor and prepare the opposite-direction PPU destinations. At row seven temporarily reverse transition direction to build the boundary row; restore direction after the special row update. Resolve the room pointer, decode four tile groups per row and stage both halves of the tile row. Merge the old/new attribute nibbles using direction-specific masks. Copy four decoded tiles into each queue/staging plane while advancing source and destination cursors. Preserve the unaffected attribute quadrant and replace the other quadrant from the decoded terrain palette bits. Build nametable high/low destinations for two tile rows and an attribute row, set inclusive payload counts and terminate the queue with $FF. Build the neighboring room only when within the stage column count and its room-list entry is not $FF. Otherwise leave the wrapped cursor unchanged. Check the previous room and encode the left-half destination before building its staged column group. Decode up to four groups into four tile planes and attributes, skipping the wrapped boundary group. Queue four sixteen-tile rows plus four attributes. Use the wrapped row to form tile/attribute destinations and inclusive counts. Edge rows one and seven need shortened queue layouts and masked attribute nibbles. Move the last attribute command over the unused tile plane, preserving only the low nibbles for the boundary. Remove the first two staged rows, preserve the high attribute nibbles and submit the shortened upload queue.

Generate a child when cooldown expires, move left and initialize slot three with animation $5A/handler $38 after crossing the world-X threshold.
